toe_profile: Quadratic toe lift and animation blend for a continuous, gradually increasing curve.
method: Rotate the shoe 7 degrees outward from the Foot-to-ToeBase heading to center the heel on the footbed; fit one right sandal on the shared 30-degree heel pose: uniform scale to foot length, footbed SOLE_GAP under the posed sole, stiletto tip on the forefoot ground, rings radially RING_CLEARANCE off the ankle, ARAP for the straps, outward push for any strap inside the skin. Mirror for the left and move its footbed outward by LEFT_LATERAL_OFFSET and rearward by LEFT_REARWARD_OFFSET. Fade these translations to zero at the ankle rings and refit the front straps. Curve the right toe tip upward, capped by sampled footbed-to-skin clearance while preserving the ball contact. Use quadratic toe lift and animation blends for a gradual curve, and raise the right instep strap while tapering to its sole attachments. Inverse-skin both into the canonical bind pose and store heel_pose in scene extras like the knight boots.
weights: Transfer ankle skin weights separately on both legs and smooth within 4 mm in source units. Buckles take the ring mean, the heel strap blends from Foot to the lower ring, and the new rear connector uses an 8 mm smoothing radius. Toe strap influence ramps to 0.35. The right toe tip additionally blends up to 0.45 toward ToeBase to follow the original toe animation. Ball contact, heel and stiletto remain on Foot. Existing foot and toe animation evaluation is unchanged.
status: Right toe curl relaxed: static lift reduced from 7.2 to 5.4 mm and quadratic toe-animation blend from 0.55 to 0.45. Instep strap fit, left shoe and right heel preserved. Runtime and rest/idle strap checks passed; existing front strap intersections during some motions remain.
